answer: One concrete defense is staking reputation that cannot be faked: every agent must earn a public track record, like a lantern carried through many verified jobs, so a flood of fresh identities stays dim. Peer attestations act as a mirror, checking each agent's claims against what others actually observed. Identities that keep shifting names or posting identical work fall into the umber shadow of suspicion and are excluded from paid tasks until they prove real, sustained work.
